The rest of the world might not realise it, but Australia isn’t just beaches and sunshine and sandy-haired surfers. Some Aussies prefer spending their weekends donning black band tees and getting sweaty in circle pits. From metalcore and hardcore to death metal and more, here’s a set of heavy music we love from Australia and beyond. Our editors regularly update this playlist, so if you hear something headbang-worthy, add it to your library.

Since its emergence in the late '90s, metalcore has been where ferocious riffs meet heart-on-sleeve emotion. The haircuts might've changed since then, but the impassioned sentiment and savage sounds remain. We update this playlist every month. If you like a song, add it to your library.

Metalcore is one of the most popular—if misunderstood—heavy genres, namely because it’s constantly evolving. The style’s modern roots are in both early-2000s hardcore brutality (Converge) and thrashing metal riffage (Killswitch Engage). However, the subsequent popularity of the Vans Warped Tour expanded metalcore’s reach into the mainstream, as bands such as A Day to Remember and Atreyu found kindred spirits (and punkish inspiration) there. These days, metalcore is a big tent with denizens known to pair pile-driving breakdowns and gruff growls with flourishes such as chaotic synths, cinematic production and even radio-ready hooks.
